description: Count null and empty cells by column and list affected row numbers. Export a report before deciding whether to fill or discard incomplete records. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Whitespace-only strings count as missing; zero and false do not. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: data_missing
title: Find missing values
